# vendored vis-network

`vis-network.min.js` (v9.1.9, standalone UMD build) is bundled here so that
generated graph HTML pages are fully self-contained and work offline / in
networks where CDNs are slow or blocked.

- Upstream: https://visjs.org / https://github.com/visjs/vis-network
- Version: 9.1.9
- License: MIT (see https://github.com/visjs/vis-network/blob/master/LICENSE)
- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vis-network@9.1.9/standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js

If this file is deleted, generated pages automatically fall back to loading
the library from jsdelivr -> unpkg -> npmmirror CDNs.
